name: Suzukaze Aoba
source: Aoba is a recent high school graduate who joins the game company Eagle Jump at the start of the series. She works as a character designer and wanted to join Eagle Jump because they produced her favorite game. Due to her small stature, she is often mistaken for a middle school student.
